description: "What part of this thesis is observation, and what part is story?" - Decompose a contrarian or heterodox thesis into atoms; classify each atom (observation / inference / intent-attribution / satellite); verdict each atom on its own evidence — never the thesis as a bundle. Use when (1) evaluating a thesis that mainstream coverage dismisses wholesale, (2) a claim mixes documented facts with attributed motives, (3) a "conspiracy theory" label is doing the analytical work, (4) deciding what evidence would grow the kernel or collapse the shell. Intent-attributions are UNVERIFIED by construction — say so. Does NOT trigger for: quick factual checks, or theses already decomposed to single claims.
